units.source_text: 小姐以为喊她，稍许侧着脸望了望夫人。

en.t: The young lady thought she was being called, and turned her face slightly to look at the lady.

units.source_text: 那少年般纯真直率的眼神，宛如毫无感情阴影的明亮窗户一般，反而使夫人顿时张皇失措。

en.t: Those boyishly innocent and straightforward eyes, like bright windows with no shadow of emotion at all, instead made the lady suddenly flustered.

units.source_text: 尽管夫人感到自嘲，但她只好又去嘲笑别人。

en.t: Although the lady felt a sense of self-mockery, she could only turn again to mocking someone else.
